services.name: Web Application Development
services.shortDescription: Custom responsive web apps, high-throughput portals, and high-converting enterprise frontends.
services.fullDescription: We engineer resilient, high-speed web platforms utilizing modern micro-frontend and server-driven architectures. From bespoke SaaS dashboards to mission-critical portals, our applications achieve sub-second load times and flawless accessibility across all devices.
benefits: Zero technical debt with strict typed standards
High conversion rates through frictionless UX

services.name: Mobile App Engineering
services.shortDescription: Cross-platform and native iOS & Android applications with buttery 60fps animations.
services.fullDescription: We build intuitive, engaging mobile experiences that achieve top app store ratings. Our mobile engineering team specializes in seamless offline data synchronization, hardware integrations, push telemetry, and biometric authentication.
benefits: Single codebase efficiency with native-grade performance
Rapid time to market across App Store and Google Play

services.name: AI Solutions & Intelligent Agents
services.shortDescription: Autonomous AI agents, custom LLM fine-tuning, RAG pipelines, and enterprise automation.
services.fullDescription: Accelerate your operational efficiency with intelligent AI solutions. We construct specialized autonomous multi-agent workflows, semantic vector search engines, automated customer support agents, and private retrieval-augmented generation systems.

services.name: SaaS Product Engineering
services.shortDescription: Multi-tenant cloud SaaS platforms, billing subscriptions, and scalable database architectures.
services.fullDescription: From seed stage validation to enterprise scale, we build end-to-end multi-tenant Software-as-a-Service platforms. We handle team access control (RBAC), Stripe/Paddle merchant integration, usage-based metering, and audit logging.
features: Tiered Stripe & Merchant of Record Billing

services.name: UI/UX & Product Design
services.shortDescription: Conversion-obsessed product interfaces, comprehensive Figma design systems, and rapid prototyping.
services.fullDescription: Exceptional engineering requires immaculate design. Our product designers create world-class digital experiences that elevate brand prestige, reduce customer drop-off, and turn complex workflows into intuitive software flows.
benefits: Consistent brand identity across all touchpoints

services.name: Cloud, API & Backend Architecture
services.shortDescription: Ultra-fast REST & GraphQL microservices, database optimization, and Kubernetes container systems.
services.fullDescription: We design unbreakable, self-healing backend systems capable of processing millions of concurrent requests. Our engineers implement distributed caching, event-driven queues, resilient message brokers, and bank-grade data encryption.

portfolio.title: AuraPay - Global FinTech & Merchant Gateway
portfolio.shortDescription: Next-generation cross-border payment gateway processing over $120M in monthly transactional volume.
portfolio.challenge: The client needed to consolidate 14 regional banking rails into a unified, high-speed API gateway while maintaining PCI-DSS Level 1 compliance and sub-200ms latency worldwide.
portfolio.solution: Architected a distributed microservices framework with edge routing, biometric tokenization, automated FX hedging, and a stunning real-time merchant analytics dashboard.
portfolio.result: Achieved 99.995% uptime during peak holiday bursts, reduced failed transaction rates by 38%, and scaled seamlessly to 250,000 active global merchants.

portfolio.title: Synthetix AI - Enterprise Contract Intelligence
portfolio.shortDescription: Autonomous LLM-driven contract extraction and compliance verification platform for Fortune 500 legal teams.
portfolio.challenge: Legal analysts were spending an average of 18 hours manually auditing multi-hundred-page commercial agreements for risk indemnification and regulatory liabilities.
portfolio.solution: Engineered a custom multi-stage RAG engine with hybrid semantic and BM25 vector search, chunk-level confidence scoring, and interactive citation highlighting.
portfolio.result: Reduced contract review turnaround by 82% while boosting discrepancy detection accuracy to 99.1% across 45,000+ audited enterprise agreements.

portfolio.title: OmniHealth - Telehealth & Remote Care iOS/Android
portfolio.shortDescription: HIPAA-compliant telemedicine app connecting patients with top specialists across the GCC region.
portfolio.challenge: Existing video consultation software suffered from frequent network drops in low-bandwidth areas and cumbersome prescription workflow handoffs.
portfolio.solution: Built a custom WebRTC video pipeline with adaptive bitrate scaling, integrated electronic health records (EHR), and automated pharmacy dispatching.
portfolio.result: Onboarded 180,000 active patients in the first 6 months, maintained a 4.9-star rating on the App Store, and facilitated over 500,000 virtual consultations.

portfolio.title: LuxeAtelier - Headless Luxury Commerce
portfolio.shortDescription: Ultra-fast headless commerce platform tailored for bespoke luxury apparel with 3D product previews.
portfolio.challenge: Monolithic e-commerce platform suffered from 6-second page load times and inability to deliver tailored multi-currency luxury styling experiences.
portfolio.solution: Implemented Next.js Edge rendering, headless Shopify storefront integration, interactive WebGL 3D garment visualization, and localized checkout flows.
portfolio.result: Lighthouse performance score jumped from 32 to 98. Mobile conversion rate increased by 64% with average order value rising 28%.

faqs.question: How do you manage international clients across different time zones?
faqs.answer: We structure our engineering sprints with overlapping hours across North American (EST/PST), European (GMT/CET), and Middle Eastern (GST) timezones. Every client is assigned a dedicated senior technical lead with real-time Slack/Teams access and weekly video sprint demos.

faqs.question: What is your typical project timeline and delivery structure?
faqs.answer: For MVP and focused applications, our timeline ranges from 3 to 6 weeks. For comprehensive enterprise systems, multi-month phased roadmaps are established with continuous bi-weekly staging deployments so you can test features as they are built.

faqs.question: Do I own 100% of the intellectual property and source code?
faqs.answer: Yes, completely. Upon final milestone sign-off and payment, full intellectual property rights, repository ownership, deployment scripts, and documentation are transferred to your organization with zero licensing lock-in.

faqs.question: Can we order directly through Fiverr or marketplace contracts?
faqs.answer: Yes! We maintain verified Pro marketplace accounts on Fiverr where you can initiate standardized gig orders with milestone escrow protection, instant reviews, and standardized deliverables. See our Marketplace page for ready-to-start services.

faqs.question: What post-launch maintenance and SLA support do you offer?
faqs.answer: We provide tailored 24/7 SLA maintenance agreements covering cloud infrastructure monitoring, proactive security patches, bug fixes, database optimizations, and ongoing feature iterations.
